device_name: GlucoSense CGM Sensor System (Gen 2, minor design iteration)
intended_purpose: A continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system intended to measure interstitial glucose levels in adults and children with diabetes mellitus, providing real-time glucose readings and trend alerts to support diabetes self-management.
device_description: Subcutaneous wearable glucose sensor (14-day wear, factory-calibrated), functionally and materially identical to the predicate GlucoSense Gen 1 device (CE-marked 2024) except for a minor adhesive formulation change. Measures interstitial fluid glucose via an enzymatic (glucose oxidase) electrochemical sensor.
clinical_data_summary: No new pivotal clinical trial was performed. Clinical evidence for this generation relies entirely on demonstrated equivalence to the predicate GlucoSense Gen 1 device (identical sensing technology, identical intended purpose, materially equivalent adhesive with supporting biocompatibility data) per MDCG 2020-5, supplemented by the predicate's existing post-market surveillance data.
risk_summary: Risk management file per ISO 14971 identifies 30 hazards, inherited from the predicate device's risk file with additional review of the adhesive change; no new hazards identified. All residual risks rated acceptable after mitigation.
